overview: The Shadow Rift Basin is the convergence point of all corruption flowing through Shadow Valley.
history: The basin formed when multiple fractures collapsed inward.
Shadow conduits were rerouted to feed energy into the basin.
Akhevan overseers established ritual platforms around the rift.
The basin became the gateway to the valley’s inner sanctum.
hooks: A massive surge erupts from the basin.
Akhevan overseers attempt a dangerous ritual.
A shadow vortex threatens to expand into nearby zones.
